research_status: COMPLETE — all 51 episodes of the original 2003 Fullmetal Alchemist TV series classified canon/filler. Sourced from two independently-fetched filler guides (epicdope.com, QuoteTheAnime) whose episode-by-episode classifications matched exactly. This series has no genuinely disputed episodes between the two sources, but the 'filler' status covers two structurally different things the project's 3-value schema doesn't separate: 3 pure standalone filler episodes (4, 10, 37) and 28 episodes of the anime's own original story continuation once it outpaced the still-ongoing manga (from episode 29 onward, with a handful of earlier original episodes interspersed) — both are 'filler' under this project's manga-adaptation definition, distinguished via each episode's status_note. Complete, gap-free, non-overlapping coverage of 1–51 confirmed before writing this file. A third site (aniyume.net) was checked for Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood cross-reference (see that file) but was not used here.

citation_sources.description: epicdope.com's Fullmetal Alchemist (2003) filler guide — episode-by-episode classification into manga canon, anime-original/diverging story, or pure filler.
QuoteTheAnime's combined Fullmetal Alchemist filler list (covers both the 2003 series and Brotherhood) — agreed with epicdope's guide on an identical episode-by-episode breakdown for the 2003 series.

episodes.title: A Forger's Love
episodes.status_note: Pure standalone filler episode, no connection to the manga or to the 2003 anime's own original continuation story — agreed identically by both cross-referenced guides.

episodes.title: The Man with the Mechanical Arm
episodes.status_note: Anime-original content, not adapted from Hiromu Arakawa's manga — the manga was still ongoing when this 2003 anime aired, so from here the anime diverges into its own original continuation (a different central antagonist, Dante, and a different ending than the manga's). Classified 'filler' under this project's manga-adaptation-based definition, though multiple fan guides caution these episodes are plot-critical to the 2003 anime's own story and not skippable padding, unlike the three pure standalone filler episodes (4, 10, 37).
